compatibility.version_semantics: health.version is the HTTP API contract marker, not the provider release

operation_semantics.timeline: derived: GET /sessions/{id} validates the session, then GET /observations (project-scoped, bounded by limit) is filtered by session_id in the adapter; upstream exposes no per-session listing
operation_semantics.empty_lists: Engram serializes empty Go slices as JSON null; the adapter normalizes null to an empty list
operation_semantics.client_errors: HTTP 4xx from Engram raises EngramClientError (caller error); only connection failures and 5xx map to ProviderUnavailable/degraded
